completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: A current-tree receipt binds the parent and datasets commits, all child receipts, capability matrix, translations, fixtures, external-tool identities, conformance population, benchmark report, rollout policy, and zero proof-authority boundary violations.

The check reports parent commit, gitlink, embedded HEAD, embedded origin/main, cleanliness, and availability of required logic modules; mismatches fail with actionable diagnostics and never rewrite a checkout.

LFV-G005.title: Align and continuously verify the datasets submodule

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: The matrix distinguishes declared, discoverable, installed, smoke-tested, translation-conformant, reconstruction-capable, shadow, canary, and authoritative-for states; stale paths and inconsistent metadata are test failures.

LFV-G010.title: Produce an executable capability census and maturity matrix

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: FOL, deontic, modal, CEC/DCEC, TDFOL, FLogic, bridges, caches, ZKP, API, CLI, MCP, and lazy import behavior have exact reviewed fixtures; optional-tool absence is recorded separately from success.

LFV-G011.title: Freeze the existing public logic and proof-authority surface

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: The registry covers existing and planned families including Horn/CHC and PDR/IC3 operations, rejects alias collisions and silent semantic equivalence, declares native, translated, declaration-only, and unsupported support, serializes deterministically, and imports no provider runtime.

LFV-G012.title: Define the canonical logic-family and provider-capability taxonomy

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Typed normalizers preserve unknown, timeout, unavailable, unsupported, malformed, witness, assumptions, bounds, translation ceiling, and resource usage; adversarial tests reject every cross-authority substitution.

LFV-G013.title: Generalize typed backend results and authority normalization

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Argument arrays avoid shell interpretation; workspaces are isolated; timeouts terminate process trees; output and paths are bounded; secrets are redacted; fake runners make tests deterministic; imports and probes install nothing.

LFV-G014.title: Build one bounded external-tool process lifecycle

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Requests/responses round trip canonically across the submodule boundary; provider discovery stays lazy; cancellations and resources are representable; supervisor compatibility is additive; dataset code never imports the parent package.

LFV-G015.title: Reconcile datasets and supervisor provider contracts

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Documents are immutable or defensively copied, canonical identity excludes observational output, every property and assumption is source mapped, extensions are namespaced, and unsupported constructs survive as diagnostics.

LFV-G020.title: Create the shared software-verification IR and property vocabulary

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Receipts bind source/target family and versions, compilers, assumptions, bounds, unsupported constructs, preservation claim, witnesses, semantic mutations, and authority ceiling; missing or stale receipts fail closed.

State schemas are typed and deterministic; actions expose read/write frames; initial/next/invariant/fairness roles are distinct; finite bounds are explicit; invalid or ambiguous transitions fail closed.

LFV-G022.title: Add state, transition, action-system, and Kripke semantics

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Finite-prefix, infinite-trace, and branching-time semantics are non-interchangeable; time units and interval boundaries are canonical; monitorable fragments are declared; CTL/CTL-star remain declaration/translation-only until a conformant semantics-preserving backend exists; clean prefixes never imply global proof.

LFV-G023.title: Add event, trace, LTL, LTLf, MTL, CTL, and CTL-star semantics

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Source locations and evaluation order are retained; normal and exceptional exits are separate; purity, effects, frames, and undefined behavior are explicit; malformed CFGs and unbound symbols fail closed.

LFV-G024.title: Add program, CFG, contract, Hoare, and dynamic-logic semantics

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Each obligation binds its source construct, assumptions, generated symbols, rule, and parent contract; loop rules require invariant/variant policy; unsupported effects remain explicit; mutation tests detect dropped branches and frames.

LFV-G025.title: Generate weakest preconditions and verification conditions

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Ownership and aliasing are typed; separating and ordinary conjunction differ; permissions are bounded and conserved; frame inference emits explicit obligations; unsupported heap theories cannot silently lower to plain FOL.

LFV-G026.title: Add separation, heap, ownership, and resource logic

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Environment and component steps are distinct; interference and fairness assumptions are explicit; session duality and simulation relations validate; bounded schedules never claim unbounded refinement.

LFV-G027.title: Add concurrency, rely-guarantee, session, and refinement semantics

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: The IR is finite and stratification-aware; allow, deny, conflict, and unknown are distinct; delegation depth and trust roots are bounded; authorization decisions cannot masquerade as theorem proof.

LFV-G028.title: Add authorization, Datalog, and SecPAL-style semantics

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Protocol models are source bound and typed; trust/adversary/channel assumptions are explicit; claims distinguish secrecy, reachability, correspondence, and equivalence; unsupported equational theories fail closed.

Trace cardinality and quantifier order are canonical; observations and declassification are explicit; self-composition declares finite bounds; a bounded witness or clean sample cannot become universal proof.

Supported Python and JavaScript/TypeScript subsets plus Intent and Security fixtures generate source-bound shared artifacts and obligations; language/runtime/memory/undefined-behavior assumptions are explicit; existing domain identities remain stable; unsupported syntax and semantics are retained; fake-backend-only success is replaced by canonical backend requests.

LFV-G031.title: Build source and domain adapters into the shared IR

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Supported arithmetic, equality, arrays/maps, datatypes, quantifiers, Horn/CHC reachability, state transitions, VCs, heap/resource fragments, interference, and refinement obligations have golden SMT-LIB; theorem-by-negation, SAT, and fixed-point queries are explicit; PDR/IC3 claims are capability bound; unsupported temporal, heap, concurrency, or refinement features cannot become uninterpreted native claims.

LFV-G040.title: Implement the shared semantic SMT compiler

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Both adapters run identical canonical VCs when available, expose explicit unavailability otherwise, agree on reviewed fixtures, preserve disagreement evidence, reject malformed outputs, and bind versions/resources/translations.

LFV-G041.title: Run shared verification conditions through Z3 and CVC5

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Vampire/E/TPTP and native DCEC/TDFOL results are typed, bounded, and source bound; heuristic/duck-typed success is removed; unreconstructed ATP output remains candidate; reviewed legacy behavior remains compatible.

LFV-G042.title: Normalize Vampire, E, DCEC, TDFOL, and legacy prover adapters

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Routing is deterministic and side-effect free; capability gaps are explicit; order cannot change final authority; disagreement quarantines; candidates route to reconstruction; resource and assurance policy bound every plan.

Generated modules/configs are deterministic and source mapped; state, concurrency, rely/guarantee, and refinement projections disclose losses; TLC and Apalache capabilities/bounds differ explicitly; counterexamples parse and replay; liveness/fairness limitations are disclosed; absent JVM/tools return unavailable.

LFV-G044.title: Generalize TLA+, TLC, and Apalache state-model checking

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Python and TypeScript agree on interval boundaries, clocks, missing/late events, violations, inconclusive prefixes, and serialization; results always have monitor authority; no-violation-observed never becomes proof.

LFV-G045.title: Build generic runtime MTL with portable TypeScript parity

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: The reference evaluator and available external engine agree on allow/deny/conflict/unknown fixtures; recursion/delegation/resources are bounded; explanations bind rules; engine output cannot grant theorem authority.

LFV-G046.title: Implement Datalog and SecPAL-style authorization backends

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Compilers disclose the Dolev-Yao/symbolic-model ceiling, equational theory, and claim support; tool versions and Maude/opam dependencies bind receipts; attack traces normalize and replay; disagreement and inconclusive results quarantine; missing tools are explicit.

LFV-G047.title: Implement Tamarin and ProVerif protocol backends

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Each engine has separate discovery/capabilities; quantifier order and observation maps survive translation; counterexample trace tuples replay; fallback bounds are explicit; absent tools and unsupported alternation return non-success.

LFV-G048.title: Implement HyperLTL, AutoHyper, and MCHyper backends

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Kernel receipts bind exact theorem, imports, generated proof, toolchain, source tree, and translation; Lean `sorry`/unsafe axioms and Rocq/Coq `Admitted` are rejected or explicitly downgrade authority; native and WASM/browser-compatible capability states are separate and real WASM absence is explicit; failure diagnostics are inert and bounded; unavailable kernels never pass.

LFV-G049.title: Normalize Lean and Rocq/Coq kernel-checking backends

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Premise selection, SMT/ATP search, proof candidates, reconstruction, and kernel receipts are separate stages; provider sets are registry driven; unreconstructed success is candidate only; Isabelle `sorry` and unreviewed axiomatization reject or downgrade authority; Isabelle path metadata is corrected.

LFV-G050.title: Integrate Isabelle and Hammer reconstruction as canonical backends

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Advisors rank premises/views and propose bounded repairs without changing sources, assumptions, modalities, or trust; checkpoints bind schemas/code/data; duplicate/source-family-safe splits pass; outputs are candidate only.

LFV-G060.title: Generalize the autoencoder into a bounded formalization advisor

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Inputs/outputs are bounded and sanitized; prompts/responses are inert and source bound; generic `is_valid`, similarity, or confidence never yields proof; accepted candidates require deterministic compilation and independent solver/kernel validation.

LFV-G061.title: Normalize Leanstral and SymAI as untrusted proposal providers

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Keys bind IR/property/assumptions, translation, backend/binary/version/config, resources, tree, and policy; single-flight and negative TTL behavior are deterministic; stale/tampered entries reject; cache never raises authority.

LFV-G062.title: Unify exact caches with the immutable proof corpus

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Public inputs bind theorem/property, translation, receipt, tree, policy, circuit, CRS/setup ceremony, proving-key and verification-key identities, backend, revocation policy, and freshness; private witnesses never serialize; simulated/circuit-mismatched/stale/revoked attestations fail; attestation is orthogonal to and preserves underlying semantic authority.

LFV-G063.title: Bind production ZKP attestations to trusted proof receipts

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: API imports quietly without optional tools; discovery is declarative; responses expose typed status/authority/assumptions/bounds/translations/witnesses/cache provenance; absent features are explicit; legacy API behavior stays green.

LFV-G070.title: Expose the stable Python software-verification API

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: CLI/MCP cover list, capability, compile, check, monitor, portfolio, counterexample, receipt, advisor, and attestation operations; schemas match Python; inputs/outputs are bounded; errors and unavailable tools are stable and secret safe.

LFV-G071.title: Expose equivalent CLI and MCP verification operations

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Analysis families, property kinds, translation forms, matrix entries, capability probes, providers, routes, resources, caches, and receipts map losslessly; supervisor-local facades remain compatible; datasets imports are lazy; cross-repo current-revision checks pass.

LFV-G072.title: Adapt the agent supervisor to the canonical logic platform

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Fake runners cover every adapter offline; opt-in real-tool lanes declare skips/unavailability; semantic mutations are detected; counterexamples replay; disagreements quarantine; no authority upgrade or stale-cache acceptance occurs.

LFV-G080.title: Build the cross-family and cross-provider conformance corpus

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: Seven deterministic examples bind sources to IR, translations, requests, results, witnesses, receipts, and declared assurance; unavailable optional tools degrade explicitly; at least one negative/counterexample case exists per lane.

TLC, Hyper tools, Datalog/SecPAL, and runtime-MTL gaps are declared; installs require explicit calls and pins/checksums; JVM/opam/Maude/circuit dependencies are bound; malicious paths/output/process trees and secret leakage are contained.

LFV-G082.title: Harden installers, resources, isolation, and adversarial behavior

completion_evidence.acceptance_criterion: The matrix is generated from current executable evidence; benchmarks report semantic and resource distributions without timing-ratio correctness gates; rollout is property specific and reversible; receipt binds all 41 child goals with zero authority-boundary violations.

LFV-G083.title: Benchmark, document, roll out, and issue the completion receipt
